issues.title: A sharp market reversal, but India's activity pulse stays expansionary
issues.summary: Sensex and Nifty fall after a four-week rally as banks and metals lead losses. November flash PMI remains expansionary, the RBI conducts two VRR auctions and the rupee weakens.

issues.title: India's rally meets a global risk reset
issues.summary: Sunday market brief: Friday's Indian rebound and rupee strength meet a global technology-led correction, renewed Middle East risk and a shortened week ahead.

issues.title: Indian equities defy the global sell-off as banks lead the Friday rebound
issues.summary: Weekend edition: Friday's domestic recovery, a stronger rupee and a fourth weekly gain contrasted with a technology-led global sell-off.
